title: Foundations for a Unified Stochastic Framework: Bridging Physics, Biology, and Socio-Economic Systems
content: This paper proposes a unified stochastic framework that reveals randomness as a fundamental mechanism through which order emerges across physics, biology, and socio-economic systems. Challenging traditional deterministic models, we demonstrate how stochastic dynamics — from quantum fluctuations to neural plasticity and market behavior — generate self-organization, adaptability, and stability. Through the integration of stochastic differential equations, entropy-based formulations, and probabilistic network dynamics, we construct a mathematical foundation for understanding complex systems. Key concepts such as stochastic resonance, critical phenomena, synchronization, and fluctuation theorems are explored across disciplines. The findings suggest a paradigm shift: randomness is not a source of chaos to be controlled, but a structural principle from which organization arises. This framework not only unifies diverse scientific fields but also offers practical applications in artificial intelligence, climate modeling, and economic forecasting.
